propertyDetails.description: Your search for the perfect home ends at Sunnyvale Crossings Apartments. Located in the heart of Sunnyvale, CA, our community offers modern amenities, stylish interiors, and inviting leisure spaces that create an exceptional living experience. With top attractions like Levi's Stadium, Homestead Shopping Center, Mariposa Shopping Center, Lawrence Station Shopping Center, and Baylands Park just minutes away, along with proximity to major employers such as Apple's Cupertino Campus, San Jose International Airport, Kaiser Permanente, and Santa Clara University, you'll have everything you need at your fingertips. Plus, being situated within an award-winning school district makes our community even more desirable. Contact us today to schedule a tour and discover why Sunnyvale Crossings Apartments is the perfect place to call home.
